entries.title: Both, unfortunately
entries.body: She asked whether I was looking at her or her sister. I said I could explain. One eye followed the sister out. I have never needed so urgently to possess a simpler face.
entries.imageFit: The independently angled compound eyes dominate the inspected photograph. The fictional conversation concerns this visible anatomy; it does not claim the sisters are in the frame.
entries.canonConsequence: Tavi's confidence in his superior perception becomes a liability in an intimate conversation. Do not reuse divided-eye attraction as a generic joke for other entries.

entries.title: A little mystery
entries.body: Someone said I should leave a little to the imagination. I tried turning sideways. My intestine came with me.
entries.imageFit: The inspected transparent swimming sea cucumber has a conspicuous loop of gut. The punchline depends on that immediately visible feature.
entries.canonConsequence: Vera is willing to flirt but cannot perform physical secrecy. Avoid making all her entries variations on transparency.

entries.title: I stayed with the light
entries.body:
The light followed me. I went left. It went left. I stopped, and the enormous thing behind it stopped too.

I had tucked all my arms underneath me. Nothing down here had ever wanted such a thorough look. After a while I opened them a little. The thing held still.

Perhaps it was frightened. It had brought so much light.

I swam beside it until it began to rise. It was very slow, and kept looking back. I went a little way up with it, then turned toward the bottom.

For the rest of the night I kept checking behind me. I hope it found whatever it had come down here to find. It seemed terribly poorly equipped to be alone.
entries.imageFit: The inspected photograph shows a dumbo octopus illuminated against deep black water, fins extended and arms gathered beneath it. The observer becomes an imagined vulnerable visitor, not a predator asserted by the image.
entries.canonConsequence: Nell interprets an intrusive research vehicle as a nervous stranger. The scene is explicitly fictional, not a claim about the photographed expedition or measured octopus cognition. Later stories may remember the visitor without making every encounter a light metaphor.
